title: Maximal-prefix coupling conditional-expectation candidate for PAH-OMC-020
purpose: Give the missing N2a comparison a concrete non-coordinate candidate without changing PAH-001.  The candidate is deliberately admitted only for finite coupling algebra and local-cylinder recovery; it is not a source-authorized owner packet and does not assert the PAH temporal theorem.

provenance.owner_authority: TECT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM (candidate declaration; source-owner sign-off still required)

fixed_scope.model_firewall: No functional, rate, state, carrier, regulator, counterterm or time change; retain the original external unaccelerated Markov time and j-before-n order.
fixed_scope.finite_spaces: X_n is the original labelled PAH finite state space with nu_n; X_infty is the R-510 compatible local-state realization with nu_infty. No phasewise or cross-Q direct sum is used.
fixed_scope.target: H=L2(X_infty,nu_infty) with the R-512 minimal closed form as the eventual target, not as an input to the coupling algebra.
fixed_scope.local_algebra: A bounded continuous gauge-invariant cylinder f supported in Lambda_k is evaluated on the common prefix whenever the coupled prefixes agree.
fixed_scope.limit_order: The preregistered j->infinity passage at fixed n precedes the n comparison; this candidate does not alter either order.

map.prefix_density_reference: For each m, p_(n,m) and p_(infty,m) are the exact Lambda_m marginal densities relative to their common Lebesgue-times-labelled-counting reference.
map.modulus: delta_(n,m)=min(1,4*D_m*q^(n-m)) from the R-510 bounded-measurable prefix estimate.
map.diagonal_index: m_n=max{0<=m<n: delta_(n,m)<=1/(m+1)^2}; the set contains m=0 because delta is capped at one, and m_n tends to infinity by the fixed-m exponential bound.
map.coupling: Use the maximal-overlap coupling of the two Lambda_(m_n) marginals, then conditionally extend the finite and infinite tails by regular conditional laws. The common-prefix mass is 1-TV_(n,m_n).
map.operator: For f in L2(nu_n), (U_n f)(x)=E[f(Y_n)|X_infty=x] under that coupling. This is a non-coordinate positive unital linear contraction by conditional Jensen.
map.local_error: If f is supported in Lambda_k and k<=m_n, ||U_n f-f||_(L2(nu_infty))^2 <= 4||f||_infinity^2 TV_(n,m_n) <= 2||f||_infinity^2/(m_n+1)^2.
map.inner_product_error: For fixed f,g in Lambda_k, combine the preceding coupling error with |nu_n(fg)-nu_infty(fg)|<=4||f||_infinity||g||_infinity D_k q^(n-k); this is an N1 local recovery bound only.

assumptions: The R-510 prefix estimate applies to the bounded measurable Lambda_m unit ball, not only a finite diagnostic grid.
The finite-dimensional labelled prefix spaces are standard Borel and admit regular conditional probabilities for the finite and limiting Gibbs laws.
The maximal-overlap coupling is chosen from the exact prefix marginal densities before any energy estimate; no fitted weight is introduced.
The common target H and R-512 form are retained exactly at their pinned scope.
proved_scope: The coupling is genuinely non-coordinate and avoids assuming a bounded terminal density-ratio pullback.
Conditional expectation is a positive unital L2 contraction for the declared coupling.
The mismatch probability equals the prefix total-variation distance and gives an explicit bounded-cylinder recovery inequality.
The diagonal threshold construction has m_n tending to infinity in the symbolic fixed-m sense, so every fixed cylinder is eventually covered by the coupling prefix.

Energy-form compatibility/intertwining for U_n on the unbounded PAH rates.
N2b arbitrary-sequence weak-liminf and compatible limsup/recovery for E_n.

decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Only after source authorization, energy compatibility, N2b, N2c/N4, N2d and independent/hostile/Lean verification are all supplied.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Only if the unchanged PAH definitions give an exact contradiction for this coupling candidate; do not promote the coordinate obstruction to this route.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: The present candidate remains here because the map has no source-owner authorization and the energy, boundary and minimal-form obligations are open.
